name: Local events, with the map and its key
The week's farmers markets, and a page per month
Hold an event to add it to your calendar
do: const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('#going .item[data-ev]:not(.past)')].filter(e => e.querySelector('.dot')); const el = all[Math.min(3, all.length - 1)]; scrollTo(0, el.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY - 330); el.classList.add('pressing', 'held'); Phone.toast('Adding to your calendar'); return 1
